acceptance_1_shared_case_file_resolution.registry_entry_summary: Extracts strategy_id, strategy_family (from metadata.strategy_family or strategy_artifact.strategy_logic.kind or strategy_id), approved_scope (from approved_scope, metadata.execution_context, or deployment_stage), artifact_state, version, and rule parameters (from metadata.strategy_artifact.parameters) within the 400-char excerpt budget.
acceptance_1_shared_case_file_resolution.strategy_pool_summary: Extracts pool_version, members (artifact_ref, stage, risk_weight, removal_reason), and pool_health with its status and unavailable_reason (from pool_health/health/decision.health and decision.reasons) within the 400-char excerpt budget.
acceptance_1_shared_case_file_resolution.member_virtual_book_summary: Resolves persona_capital_binding_id from the already-read persona-owned member registry entry (0 extra registry calls), reads telemetry runtime-summaries, summarizes each member virtual book, and records zero-observation or missing books with their named unavailable_reason (e.g. zero_observations:insufficient_or_constant_returns or virtual_book_source_missing) in both the item excerpt and facts.unavailable.

acceptance_2_unresolvable_ref.behavior: An unresolvable ref in evidence_refs stays in case_file.groups.facts.items (and case_file_items) with status='unavailable', unavailable_reason=<owner reason>, and a JSON excerpt naming registry:<ref>:<reason> instead of an excerpt equal to the ref id, alongside its entry in groups.facts.unavailable.

acceptance_3_private_memory_refusal.behavior: compose_meeting_case_file calls compose_case_file with caller.persona_id='' so persona_private memory is excluded by the shared resolver (and recorded as memory:persona_private caller_is_not_the_persona), and any persona_private item in supplied_case_file, evidence_refs, or groups raises MeetingRefusedError('private_memory_forbidden').

acceptance_4_hosted_shape_prompt_test.shape: 1 member artifact (artifact-persona-paper-039ad01f8bcd2b4aa466) with hosted execution_bundle registry entry (close_to_close_momentum, paper scope, TW 2330.TWSE, lookback_bars=2, momentum_threshold=0.0), strategy pool version 4 (risk_weight=1.0, health unknown: virtual_book_source_missing / health_window_missing_or_invalid), and telemetry virtual book with observation_count=0 (insufficient_or_constant_returns).
acceptance_4_hosted_shape_prompt_test.verified: Every participant prompt across Round 1, Round 2, and Chair Synthesis contains the resolved member registry facts, pool v4 membership and weights, and the pool health and virtual book unavailable reasons.

acceptance_5_chair_synthesis_cause.recorded_fields: meeting.synthesis.unreadable_reason, meeting.synthesis_unreadable_reason, and meeting.synthesis.summary ('Synthesis empty or unreadable (<cause>); recorded as REVIEW with no proposal.') naming model_output_missing, parse_failure (raw_length=<N|unknown>), or timeout. Inspects the full wrapped exception causal chain (__cause__, __context__, .reason) across HttpContributionProvider boundaries so JSONDecodeError preserves the actual raw document length (never inventing raw_length from diagnostic error message length), missing summary/output fields classify as model_output_missing, and transport timeouts classify as timeout.
acceptance_5_chair_synthesis_cause.hosted_events_mtg_2c016da5651a0dc4_and_m: The hosted lifecycle events for mtg-2c016da5651a0dc4 and mtg-485f7ab2970844ae do not hold which case applied: prior to this change execute_persona_meeting emitted transcript events only for round positions (meeting_round_1_position, meeting_round_2_position), wrote no synthesis event, and caught any synthesis provider exception as raw_synthesis={'unreadable': True}, collapsing all causes into the generic 'Synthesis empty or unreadable; recorded as REVIEW with no proposal.' string.

acceptance_6_runtime_budget.owner_reads_per_meeting_before: 0 case-file owner reads in compose_meeting_case_file (string evidence_refs were wrapped directly with excerpt='Evidence <ref> for <topic>'); 1 persona directory read at convene when roster is derived; N_participants memory pre-read calls and 1 learn-feedback writeback at execution.
acceptance_6_runtime_budget.owner_reads_per_meeting_after: Bounded single pass through services/knowledge/case_file.py::compose_case_file: M registry entry reads (1 per distinct member ref, M=1 on hosted, strictly capped at max_items_per_group=8 before owner reads) + F registry family history reads (1 for single-family, strictly capped at 8), 2 persona pool reads (strategy-pool and strategy-pool/versions), 0..1 telemetry runtime-summaries read (1 when persona_capital_binding_id is present on the member registry entry; 0 extra registry reads to discover the binding), 3 memory retrieve reads (institutional lessons, persona committee-shared lessons, institutional negative memory), and 0..1 search query read (when search gateway is configured) = 8 to 9 bounded HTTP reads per 1-member meeting (and at most 22 total owner HTTP reads even if >=20 refs are supplied). Execute-time migration runs only when genuinely unresolved legacy placeholder items exist and preserves all explicit/supplied items. No new persistent writer.
acceptance_6_runtime_budget.case_file_size_per_meeting_and_cap: At the hosted 1-member shape, the 3 resolved fact excerpts total ~920 chars (registry_entry ~390 chars, strategy_pool ~350 chars, member_virtual_book ~180 chars) and their additive excerpt + serialized subject_fields total ~1,750 chars (~2.5 KB total serialized case_file JSON). Strictly capped by Budgets(max_items_per_group=8, max_excerpt_chars=400, max_total_chars=12000) both inside compose_case_file and after appending meeting-supplied/explicit/unavailable items in compose_meeting_case_file: <=8 items per group across 4 groups, <=400 chars per item excerpt, <=400 serialized JSON chars per item structured subject_fields (fitting the final json.dumps(subject_fields, sort_keys=True) mapping after Unicode and quote/backslash escaping), and an additive total of sum(len(item['excerpt']) + len(json.dumps(item['subject_fields'], sort_keys=True))) <= 12,000 chars across all groups per meeting case file (tail items trimmed from the largest group until the additive excerpt + serialized subject_fields sum fits <=12,000 chars; e.g. at maximum per-item density of 400-char excerpt + <=400-char subject_fields, at most 15 items remain).
